useCase: Detecting hidden information, compression irregularities, and AI生成の JPEG 異常
mechanism: 分析します the 分布 of quantized DCT 係数 using chi-square statistics. Expected 分布s follow predictable パターン for natural images; deviations indicate 操作, AI generation, or hidden data embedding.
accuracy: Medium - 72-83% for detecting compression 異常 and AI アーティファクト
name: カイ二乗分析
parameters: ブロックサイズ: 8x8 DCT, Test: chi-square goodness-of-fit, Significance: p < 0.05, Coefficients: AC components
description: 適用します chi-square 統計的 test to DCT 係数 分布s を検出するために steganographic embedding and compression 異常 common in AI outputs.

references.title: Westfeld, A. & Pfitzmann, A. (2000). Attacks on Steganographic Systems. Information Hiding.
Fridrich, J. et al. (2003). Detection of Double-Compression in JPEG Images. Information Hiding.

strengths:
• Well-established 統計的 framework
• 検出します both steganography and AI アーティファクト
• Fast computation on DCT 係数
• Quantifiable p-value for confidence
limitations:
• Only works on JPEG compressed images
• Sensitive to image quality and size
• High compression can mask 異常
• Limited effectiveness on PNG/WebP formats
